subQuests.subQuestName: Open the strange book
Examine the surrounding area

401620303.text: Ah, you're finally awake! Paimon was worried sick!

401620306.text: No idea... Paimon just woke up, and then we were here... Paimon's head is all dizzy...

401620307.text: #The scenery here looks different, too... *whimper* What should we do, {NICKNAME}? Please don't tell Paimon someone abducted us and brought us to some strange place that we can never leave...

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue exploring along the path

401620501.text: #{NICKNAME}, did those plants by the road look weird to you? It almost looked like... they were made of paper!

401620502.text: And those two frogs over there... Yeah, they look like pieces of origami!

401620503.text: Oh! By the shade of a lotus leaf, Stream, don't tell me you forgot how to jump!

401620504.text: I... I didn't forget, Firecracker. I'm just... not sure if what I remember is correct.

401620505.text: Hah, next thing you know you'll have forgotten how to sing, much less notate a score. You still remember why we call you Stream, don't you?

401620506.text: Yeah, because I've got a great singing voice. Although, these days, the name seems more ironic than anything...

401620507.text: Not just a great voice, one that evokes the gentleness of early morning dewdrops flowing into a spring! So, cheer up, and make the jump over! If you're still unsure, just use that roll of magic thread. I won't laugh, I promise. Now, don't tell me you've forgotten how to use that as well...

401620508.text: I haven't forgotten everything, Firecracker. Your name, for instance — it's kinda hard to forget that you're named after your fiery temper. Now do me a favor, and pipe down for a second. I'll be right over.

401620509.text: Y—You saw that too, right!? Paimon's not seeing things, is she?

401620512.text: This place is getting more confusing by the second...

401620513.text: Anyway, uh... Why don't we go after those two frogs? They didn't look evil or anything. Plus, they might be able to help us out!

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the Paper Frogs
Follow the Paper Frogs

401622501.text: I've placed the bottle where you requested. The rest is up to you, my lady.

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue forward along the path

401620401.text: Guess we're not catching up to those frogs... They were so fast, Paimon couldn't even tell where they hopped off to in the end...

401620402.text: Excuse me, honored travelers... Did you come from the Cliff of Prophecy perchance?

401620403.text: Eh! The... The chubby paper hamster just talked!

401620404.text: Chubby... Who are you calling chubby? I've just got a slightly thicker layer of paper on me, that's all!

401620405.text: Ahem... Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Almond, and I'm an elder of the Forest of Blessings. I've been waiting here for the Hero of Prophecy to arrive.

401620406.text: #{NICKNAME}... Could you pinch Paimon just to make sure she's not still dreaming?

401620407.text: I think I need pinching as well...

401620408.text: Pinching, you say? I can help with that... although you'll have to get a little closer, my arms are rather short.

401620409.text: Th—That's alright... We just need a minute to collect ourselves. Okay... Let's think things through...

401620410.text: We know for sure this isn't the world we're familiar with. The talking paper animals and all the paper trees and plants make that pretty clear.

401620411.text: "The Hero from another world, supported by their companions, shall restore peace to this world..." That is what the prophecy says.

401620414.text: Oh, dearie me — I completely forgot to introduce you to this world, didn't I? And here I am, getting all excited by the arrival of the Hero... You'll have to excuse me, this old brain isn't what it once was... all shell and no nuts.

401620415.text: Perhaps my once-glossy paper has faded past the point of no return...

401620416.text: It's okay, really! You can just tell us all about this world now.

401620417.text: Let me think... Where should I even begin? I've pretty much forgotten everything that happened in the past...

401620418.text: Ah, right, I believe the story circulating along the pulp of this forest goes as follows...

401620419.text: A long, long time ago, three goddesses created this world, and named it "Simulanka."

401620420.text: The Goddess of Creation, who presides over matter and magic, created the mountains and rivers, and gave us life. Her powers also paved the way for Simulanka to exist in numerous worlds.

401620421.text: After the Goddess of Creation came the Goddess of Prophecy, with dominion over the stars and the course of fate itself. She induced the sky to spin, and the earth to move. Even to this day, her statue still stands tall at the highest point of Constellation Metropole.

401620422.text: The final Goddess was the Goddess of Fate, she who reigns over all treasured tales and dearest wishes. She bestowed upon us the fierce and everlasting feelings of love and hate, and showed us the meaning of death and hope.

401620423.text: Whoa, they all seem super impressive! Sounds like they really did a lot.

401620424.text: Of course. All new residents of Simulanka come to the Forest to thank the Goddess of Creation for founding this world, and travel to Constellation Metropole to witness the divinations of the Goddess of Prophecy's numerous oracles.

401620425.text: After that, they make their way to the end of the world, and tell the Goddess of Fate about their most cherished dreams. *sigh* At least, that's how it used to be.

401620426.text: Uh... "How it used to be"? Did something bad happen?

401620427.text: You mentioned something about "restoring peace to this world"...

401620428.text: Oh, yeah! That has to do with the Hero you're waiting for, right?

401620429.text: Yes... This old brain of mine may have forgotten many things, but I will never forget the day the evil dragon descended upon our Forest...

401620430.text: It came down from the skies in an ominous black mist and ravaged our homeland... its gigantic footprints can still be seen in the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells. We're incredibly fortunate that no one was hurt...

401620432.text: The terror doesn't stop there, I'm afraid... Ever since the attack, the Calligraphy Tavern in the forest has been closed. No one knows why, but it is a catastrophe of the highest order for us forest-dwellers.

401620433.text: Huh? A catastrophe of the highest order... all because a Tavern closed? If we were talking about Mondstadt, here, Paimon might understand, but is it really all that serious?

401620434.text: Good Goddess of Creation above, we'd take even the greatest flood over the closure of the Tavern!

401620435.text: Wet paper will dry out with time, fallen trees can be restored... But the Calligraphy Tavern is the only source of the <color=#00E1FFFF>Magic Tonic</color> that sustains all creatures in the forest!

401620437.text: Magic Tonic. It was gifted to the forest by the Goddess of Creation herself — a special potion that helps us maintain our vitality.

401620438.text: What happens if you stop drinking it?

401620439.text: Well... Our bodies will gradually crumple and become brittle, until they eventually disintegrate entirely. Our <color=#00E1FFFF>colors will fade</color>, and we'll start to lose our memory, until we can't even remember our own names...

401620440.text: Huh!? But wait, Grandpa Almond, does that mean you've already...

401620441.text: I'm afraid so... The color has all but completely faded from my paper. To be honest, all I really remember is that I'm supposed to wait here for the Hero of Prophecy. But, I've already forgotten who gave me that order to begin with...

401620442.text: Then, we've got to act fast! How can we help?

401620443.text: Oh, brave pixie, may the Goddess of Fate reward you and your friend for your kindness.

401620444.text: Could it be... you're the Heroes I've been waiting for all along?

401620445.text: Um... Not sure how we'd know that. Plus, we can't even remember how we got here. So, it's not looking too promising...

401622601.text: What flavor of Magic Tonic should I whip up first?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Hut of Blessings

401620701.text: This is the place. If you could just wait a moment, the Fairy should be—

401620704.text: ...It's really you! I'm so happy to see you!

401620708.text: So Nilou is the Forest Fairy? Well, you certainly look the part!

401620801.text: Look, the Forest Fairy is here! And she brought her companions! Grandpa Almond was right, they do look promising!

401620802.text: Hello there, everyone. I heard you were working on the piping for the Calligraphy Tavern. Is there anything we can do to help?

401620803.text: Ah, we wouldn't dream of troubling you with our petty problems, my lady! Don't you worry, we have it all under control.

401620804.text: You sure about that? Because from where Paimon's floating, the piping is looking pretty chaotic...

401620805.text: Ah, yes... we have my careless friend to thank for that. He promised we could leave the pipe-connecting to him, and... well, the results speak for themselves.

401620806.text: Hey...! I just wanted to inspect each pipe! This is the network the Magic Tonic has to flow through. I was just trying to be thorough! So, I... I disassembled the whole thing...

401620807.text: Yeah, and now you've forgotten how to put the thing back together! *sigh* Have you been eating too many nuts again? 'Cause you are what you eat...

401620808.text: Please, don't fight. I know everyone wants the Tavern to reopen as soon as possible so that the Forest can return to normal.

401620809.text: So, why don't you let us help out?

401620810.text: Yeah, we're here anyway, so we might as well be helpful! We just need to reassemble these pipes, right?

401620811.text: Well, if you're offering... Basically, the pipes need to be connected properly to allow the Magic Tonic to <color=#00E1FFFF>flow through</color>. If you put the wrong pipe in the wrong place, the Tonic will get stuck halfway...

401620813.text: Says the guy who messed the whole thing up in the first place!

401620902.text: Now, the Tonic will flow into everyone's cups without getting stuck, right?

401620903.text: Gotta say, though, Paimon is starting to get pretty curious about this Magic Tonic... Um, could she have a teeny tiny sip? Just a little taste! Please!

401620907.text: Well... if it's really just one sip, I guess that would be fine...

401620908.text: Just... Be careful! This is one of the last cups left in the entire Forest! We're supposed to save it for our research!

401620909.text: Just a sip, promise! Okay, here goes... Hmm...

401620910.text: ...Ugh! What was that? It's sticking to Paimon's tongue! Wait, is this just regular <color=#00E1FFFF>ink</color>?

401620912.text: Wait, does that mean... What the legend says is true?

401620913.text: "The Goddess of Fate used ink to compose her stories on paper, and the Goddess of Creation used her power to bring those tales to life."

401620914.text: No wonder the Tavern is so important to the Forest...

401620915.text: Maybe the Fading Disorder occurs when the ink within the body dries up... That would explain why the beings here are forgetting their own stories...

401620917.text: I'm not sure I can really wrap my head around this conversation, but there's no need to get all worked up on our behalf, my lady. With the pipe installed, I'm sure the Tavern will be up and running in no time.

401620918.text: What do you mean, can't wrap your head around it? The Fairy is recounting the story of how the Goddesses gave us life. In fact, I've seen the Goddess of Creation with my own eyes!

401620920.text: Don't be ridiculous, there's no way you're old enough to have met her! We're the same age — and I think I would know, considering we went to tell our wishes to the Goddess of Fate together! So stop talking a load of paper mache.

401620921.text: Fine... It was my grandfather, alright? He was the one that saw her.

401620922.text: He said that one day, after he finished work, he saw the Goddess of Creation grant us life with his own eyes.

401620923.text: In her hands, she held the very paper used to form our bodies. She whispered something into the pages... And then, suddenly, a paper frog was born, ready to leap into the world! Oh, it was spectacular!

401620924.text: Cut the theatrics, will you? You weren't even there...

401620925.text: Wait, so... That's it? Paimon thought creation magic would have a little bit more... pizzazz.

401620926.text: Oh! So, in your world, the creation of life is a much showier affair? I'm learning something new every day!

401620927.text: Um... Well, that's not exactly what Paimon was trying to say...

401620928.text: Magic... doesn't have to be spectacular...

401620929.text: That's enough out of you. All your boasting is confusing our kind Fairy!

401620930.text: Oh, no, it's alright. I actually think I understand the magic of this world a bit better now. Thank you.

401620931.text: The honor was all ours, my lady.

401621001.text: Stream! Your rhythm is off again! At this rate, it doesn't even matter if the Tavern reopens. The band's not going to even get any gigs.

401621003.text: Uh, hello there... I hope we aren't interrupting your rehearsal.

401621004.text: Wait, these are the two frogs we saw on the road a little while ago!

401621005.text: Ah, the Forest Fairy is here! For the love of lotus leaves and dewdrops, Stream, you've really gotta put in some effort now!

401621007.text: Oh, don't pressure yourselves on my account! Are you rehearsing for a show?

401621008.text: Sure are! You see, our group regularly performs for guests at the Tavern.

401621009.text: We've been out of work for quite some time, with the closure and all. But, after hearing of the Fairy's arrival yesterday, we figured we needed to get in performance shape right away!

401621010.text: Hehe, I understand how you feel! Back at the Grand Bazaar, Zubayr Theater's always busy with rehearsals too.

401621011.text: The Grand Bazaar? Do people there sing on lotus leaves as well?

401621012.text: Yeah, they do, and it's a reaaaaaally big one! You're the conductor of your group, aren't you? You remind me of Mr. Zubayr!

401621013.text: Ah, then he must be an ambitious director, one who would do anything to avoid disappointing a single member of the audience. It's just...

401621015.text: Is there anything we can do to help you, Mr. Stream?

401621016.text: Oh, no, no, my problems are... mine and mine alone...

401621017.text: It's just... after the Tavern closed, I somehow forgot how to sing... I'm always a few beats behind everyone else, and I keep singing out of key...

401621018.text: You were our trump card, our best singer by a mile...

401621020.text: So he is a victim of the Fading Disorder, too...

401621021.text: Don't be sad, Mr. Stream! Whenever I've forgotten important dance steps in the past, my friends at the Grand Bazaar always stick by my side to encourage me!

401621022.text: They smile, and patiently tell me everything's going to be okay. Then they play the melody for me over and over, until the steps finally come back to me... Now, it's our turn to help you.

401621023.text: #We just need to help you remember how to sing, right? {NICKNAME}'s got a great sense of rhythm. We can help keep you in time!

401621024.text: Well, what do you say, Stream? I think it's a great idea. Just focus on the lyrics, and the Fairy's friends will help you stay on beat.

401621025.text: Are... Are you sure? This is... really asking a lot...

401621026.text: Don't worry about it, Mr. Stream. It'll all be worth it when the Tavern reopens and we finally have the chance to hear your marvelous singing voice.

401621027.text: Alright then... Thank you so much, everyone. I—I'll give it my best shot!

401621903.text: Yeah, don't give up just yet! Our rhythm was probably off. Let's give it a few more tries!

401621905.text: Sure, it's good to take a breather. We can come back to this later!

401622001.text: I feel like... I'm getting the hang of it again!

401622002.text: Goddesses above, this better stick when it comes to the performance! Just do it exactly like how we rehearsed!

401622003.text: Thank you, everyone... Thanks to you, my voice is once again as clear as a flowing stream!

401622004.text: Glad to hear that you're feeling better, Mr. Stream. It's also about time for us to go to our next destination.

401622005.text: Mhm! We'll be looking forward to your performance at the Tavern!

401621201.text: My dear Citrus, please tell me you're joking. We can't have you out of commission with the Tavern about to reopen!

401621202.text: I'm sorry, Grandpa Almond, it's the truth. I was just too excited for the reopening, and must've fallen asleep in an awkward position.

401621203.text: Grandpa Almond! We're here to help!

401621204.text: Oh, hazelnuts on high, you could not have come at a better time! Please, allow me to introduce you. This is the bartender of the Calligraphy Tavern, Miss Citrus.

401621206.text: Miss Citrus is supposed to add all kinds of delicious fruits to the Magic Tonic. Her additions are what turn it into the finest brew in the land. She's indispensable to the operation of the Tavern!

401621207.text: I appreciate the kind words, Grandpa Almond, but... Owww... My neck...

401621209.text: Ah, terrible timing... getting a kink in my neck at a time like this...

401621210.text: Could you give my tail a little twist? That should help free up the movement in my neck. I would do it myself, but I can't reach on my own, and Grandpa Almond is too old, and as light as a feather...

401621211.text: The neck and tail... are connected?

401621212.text: Of course they're connected! Just like how you can't have a rainbow without rain. Anyway, you just need to position me <color=#00E1FFFF>at the right height</color> to pick the fruits, and then put them <color=#00E1FFFF>in the barrel over there</color>.

401621301.text: Perfect! My neck feels much better.

401621302.text: So there really is some kind of connection between your neck and tail...

401621303.text: Thank you so much, everyone! I can rest easy now, knowing the drinks at the Tavern will be just as wonderful as before.

subQuests.subQuestName: Help the forest dwellers with Nilou

401622701.text: ...See, I was right! That's exactly what the Goddess of Creation did all those years ago!

401622702.text: Ugh, brag away. But, don't think you're getting out of carrying all those pipes with me later.

subQuests.subQuestName: Help the forest dwellers with Nilou

401622801.text: For the sake of the Forest Fairy, Stream, please give me your best performance when we take the stage!

401622802.text: Rest easy, Firecracker. I've been waiting for this day for a very long time.

subQuests.subQuestName: Help the forest dwellers with Nilou

401622903.text: Forest... Please heed my words, and accept my blessings...

401622904.text: May your spring of wondrous magic never run dry, and may all who call you their home lead happy, fulfilling lives...

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Hut of Blessings

401621501.text: Well, since we've taken care of most of the tasks, all we need to do now is reopen the Tavern!

401621502.text: But, we still don't know how to use the magic of this world. We don't even know why the Tavern closed in the first place...

401621503.text: Huh... Oh! What about the method that one hamster mentioned? You should try it, Nilou!

401621504.text: You mean, the creation magic his grandfather saw outside the Hut of Blessings? Hmm, I wonder... How exactly did the Goddess of Creation give them life...?

401621505.text: Maybe... you don't need to understand it, just give it a try! Everyone here calls you the Forest Fairy. Maybe you have the magic powers already, and you just don't know it!

401621506.text: In other words... this Forest is a stage, and all I need to do is... step out into the spotlight? Hehe, sounds just like a fairytale!

401621507.text: Well, we are surrounded by talking origami animals and magic potions, after all... Almost seems like anything's possible in this place.

401621508.text: You're right, Paimon. We won't know anything unless we try. In that case... Let's see...

401621509.text: Nilou takes out a page from a book, and folds it into the shape of a hamster...

401621510.text: This is how you do it, right? I think I got the folds right.

401621511.text: Whoa! Your origami skills are great!

401621512.text: I once saw one of our prop people make something similar. It looked really cool, so I took some time during my break to learn the basics. It's not a bad way to stave off sleepiness, either!

401621513.text: Well, how do you feel? Sense any... uhh... magical powers flowing through you?

401621516.text: No? Hmm... What are we missing?

401621517.text: Aren't you supposed to say some magic words?

401621518.text: Magic words? But, how am I supposed to know what the Goddess said to bring them to life?

401621521.text: Ooh, good point! You're the Forest Fairy, Nilou, what do you want to say to the new resident of your domain?

401621523.text: Nilou picks up the hamster, and kisses it gently on the forehead...

401621524.text: "I bestow upon you the blessings of the forest, and offer you a home in this land..."

401621525.text: "Your name shall be Padisarah. May you bloom in this world as beautifully as the flower I love."

401621529.text: Well, peel my shell and call me a nut... I never imagined I'd witness such a miracle at my age. It's just like what the stories said about the Goddess of Creation!

401621531.text: Nice to meet you, Padisarah. I'm Nilou, the Fairy of this Forest. From this day forward, this place is now your home.

401621533.text: I hope you'll grow up happily in this Forest.

401621535.text: Hahaha, you can leave the little one with old Almond for now. Oho, this sure brings back memories... It's been such a long time since we last held a welcome ceremony.

401621536.text: Here, Padisarah. Come to Grandpa Almond.

401621537.text: Well, now that Nilou has mastered the Goddess' magic, we should be able to reopen the Tavern, right?

401621538.text: Hmm... Grandpa Almond, could you send a few people to check the underground space beneath the Tavern?

401621539.text: Oh, of course! May I ask why?

401621540.text: The moment I used magic, I sensed something... strange down there. I have a feeling it's connected to why the Tavern had to close down.

401621541.text: Of course, we'll look into it right away.

401621542.text: Make sure you listen to Grandpa Almond, Padisarah. Don't go running off on your own!

401621544.text: Hey, come back here, you! Wait!!

401621545.text: Yup, that's Nilou's creation all right. She's got so much energy... Anyway, how did you manage it, Nilou?

401621546.text: Well... All I did was say my wishes for her out loud. Maybe the magic is in the words, themselves, just like the book said!

401621547.text: This place is seeming more like a fairytale by the second.

401621548.text: I mean... we're somewhere called the Forest of Blessings, so it kind of makes sense.

401621549.text: Well, anyway, Paimon thinks this magic suits you perfectly, Nilou!

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect the materials used to make Magic Tonic
Collect the materials used to make Magic Tonic
Collect the materials used to make Magic Tonic
Collect the materials used to make Magic Tonic
Return to the Hut of Blessings

401621701.text: Give me just a second. I'm gonna go fetch an ink bottle from the other room.

401621702.text: Paimon doesn't get it... All the ingredients are super tasty, but, somehow, the final product turns into ink...

401621703.text: Well, anyway, Paimon's not going anywhere near the stuff this time, not even if you bribed her...

401621705.text: Let's see... According to the book, first you do this... then this... and then...

401621707.text: Wow, magic sure makes everything super convenient!

401621708.text: Yes, this is it... This is exactly the Magic Tonic we need!

401621709.text: Grandpa Almond, could you take the concoction to the room underneath the Tavern and place it next to the transparent bottle you found? I'll handle the rest.

401621710.text: Of course! As you command, so it shall be done!

401621711.text: Phew... I still get nervous at times like this. It's just like when you step on stage, and you can tell that every single person's gaze is fixed right on you.

401621714.text: Hehe, thanks, you two! I can't tell you how great it is to have you by my side. Almost makes me feel like I've been blessed by the Goddess of Fate, too!

401621715.text: Let's go. We shouldn't keep everyone waiting.

subQuests.subQuestName: Give the Magic Tonic to Grandpa Almond
Give the Magic Tonic to Grandpa Almond
Go to the Calligraphy Tavern
Talk to everyone

401621802.text: Wow, it's so pretty! What a beautiful Tavern!

401621803.text: It matches the scenery of the Forest perfectly. I was so surprised when it suddenly opened up like that... Just like a pop-up book!

401621805.text: ...It was me. I was the one who went to the top of <color=#00E1FFFF>Constellation Metropole</color>, and witnessed the Goddess's prophecy!

401621806.text: "The Hero who shall save this world will descend upon the Cliff of Prophecy. The Hero, supported by their companions, shall restore peace to this world."

401621807.text: So the prophecy really did have all the answers, you just forgot the first half...

401621808.text: That's why I was waiting near the Cliff of Prophecy... Haha, wonderful, simply wonderful! There's still some hope left for old Almond after all!

401621809.text: Is the Cliff of Prophecy that place with the huge mural? 'Cause that is where we woke up, but we don't remember anything about how we got there. Also, we didn't get a change of clothes like Nilou... Are we definitely the Heroes?

401621810.text: If not you, then who else? You've already helped the Fairy revitalize our Forest. To us, that makes you heroes, prophesized or not.

401621811.text: Alright! Either way, we're going to keep adventuring, even if just to figure out how we can get back to our world.

401621813.text: Yep, that's exactly right! Helping people we meet on the road is kind of our thing!

401621816.text: As expected, the words of the Goddess of Prophecy always come true.

401621817.text: I'll come with you. It can't hurt to have a magical Fairy tag along, right?

401621815.text: Yep! We've beaten up plenty of dragons already, so what's one more?

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

401629901.text: Huh? Seems like we were just sent a strange book. It does have a really nice cover, though...

401629902.text: Paimon's really curious... Let's read it and see what it's about!

401629904.text: Uh... That meadow over there looks pretty strange.

401629905.text: That's what the Calligraphy Tavern looks like, now it's lost all of its color...

401629906.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, we should make our way to the next location.

401629907.text: We've got one final stop. Let's go.
